basic_info.description: Mission Dolores Edwardian condo with a contemporary feel still maintains its period charm. Top floor condominium offers 3 spacious bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, formal living and dining room, with an open floor plan and exceptional natural light throughout. Full floor unit with remodeled bathrooms, and brand new kitchen with shaker white cabinets, quartz counter tops and in-unit W/D. Period details include original hardwood floors, double parlor with pocket doors, fireplace, built-in cabinetry, wall paneling and coffered ceilings. Deeded 1 car parking, storage unit, and an exclusive opportunity to develop a roof deck. 1 block from Dolores Park, and all shuttles stops.
